bibl.title: Reconsidering Pausanias' Possible Source for the Gallic Invasion of Greece (279/278 BC).
bibl.seg: Andrea Pierozzi, Reconsidering Pausanias' Possible Source for the Gallic Invasion of Greece (279/278 BC).
bibl.note: The historian Phylarchus emerges as a persuasive candidate as Pausanias' source. - See pp. 31-34: 3. The Epiphany of Pyrrhus / Neoptolemus. Points to a possible influence of the Ptolemaic propaganda.
